description: Introduction and overview of the Peugeot 205 GTI (1984-1994): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Peugeot 205 GTI defined the hot hatch: a 1.6 or 1.9-liter engine in a 1,900-lb body with telepathic steering. description: Engineering deep-dive of the Peugeot 205 GTI (1984-1994): Materials, structures, and the engineering decisions behind the car. The Peugeot 205 GTI defined the hot hatch: a 1.6 or 1.9-liter engine in a 1,900-lb body with telepathic steering. About 333,000 GTIs were built, and the car won fans as the best-handling hatchback of the 1980s. Clean 1.9 GTIs are now prized collectibles. Baseline facts: French hot hatch 1984-1994; ~333,000 GTIs; defined the hot-hatch formula..

power_hp = 130
weight_lb = 1980
